settings.pluginsGuideIntroTitle: 🌟 What is a TG-SignPulse Action plugin?
settings.pluginsGuideIntroDesc: Action plugins are programmable async extensions for Telegram group/channel interactions. They can listen for inbound messages and reply (reactive), or be explicitly scheduled in task pipelines (active).
settings.pluginsGuideModeReactiveDesc: Triggered by the pipeline whenever the account receives a Telegram text message. The handler must return True to signal "message captured and consumed".
settings.pluginsGuideModeActiveDesc: Invoked explicitly by sign-in tasks or external actions. No inbound message event required; it pushes outbound messages or HTTP webhooks directly via the context.
settings.pluginsGuideCtxMessage: Inbound Telegram message object (text, id, date, chat, etc.)
settings.pluginsGuideCtxReply: Quickly reply to the current inbound message
settings.pluginsGuideCtxSend: Proactively send a new text message to the current chat
settings.pluginsGuideCtxReact: React to the current message with a Telegram emoji
settings.pluginsGuideCtxStorage: Per-plugin namespaced persistent storage engine (get / set / increment)
settings.pluginsGuideCtxLog: Safe log output (streamed live in the debug modal and panel log feed)
settings.pluginsGuideMetaDesc: Declare module-level globals at the top of the plugin script, or pass them directly to {'@'}PluginRegistry.register:
